$comment: EXAMPLE relay config — replace every placeholder on the deployment host. tokenSha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the agent's bearer token (generate the token on the host with: openssl rand -hex 32; hash it with: printf %s "<token>" | sha256sum). public_key is the base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key from a Phase 4 keypair (solvec keygen prints the registry entry). Never put a token value or a private key in this file.
